overview: Medical and dental education in Switzerland follows the Bologna Process and is regulated by the Federal Medical Professions Act (MedBG), offering world-class clinical polyclinics, advanced oral research centers, and globally recognized healthcare training.
fee: CHF 1,000 - CHF 4,000 per academic year (Public) | Higher international fee in certain cantons
eligibility: 10+2 with PCB + German/French (C1) proficiency + Cantonal admission/aptitude prerequisites (EMS if applicable).
